fitted_on_what.C_reg: the registered cross_model_predict time per (arm, G, n), every number fitted on Mixtral 8x7B's 2026-09-27 pages only
fitted_on_what.F: 251.7 MB (4 x 60 MiB, the flush's read) / 3726 GB/s (the session ruler): 0.0676 ms; nothing fitted
fitted_on_what.H: each cell's own measured host enqueue per call (the duty timer's host_enqueue_ms, recorded on every cell by launch_floor); the 0.3545 ms in the numbers below is the Granite 09-30 session median, for the printed estimates only
fitted_on_what.Phi: 0.0998 ms, the median H - I on Granite's published host-bound n <= 2 cells: FITTED ON GRANITE (SEEN), used only in P8's plateau band
fitted_on_what.MP: zero fitted constants (trace-measured launch offsets, rescaled by H_E240 / H_traced, kernel durations, lambda and F)

edge_cells: a (arm, n, mode) whose host-bound fraction over its 3 repeats is in [0.2, 0.8]: excluded from P4 and P5, fixed now

source.jetmoe-8b: docs/registered/2026-09-29-jetmoe-8b-gh200.json, G=4 (primary); the CORES model at 6d2595d moves n = 1 and 3, printed as jetmoe-8b@6d2595d
source.granite-3.0-1b-a400m: cross_model_predict.py at 6d2595d + this patch, 8x7B 2026-09-27 source (timing pages 04d9320b, e20972ef, 8ab16728, 848523de, 2085264b), G=4

P1.says: GR: the Granite n = 1..5 cells are GPU-bound and read C_reg within [0.80, 1.10] x C_reg; I_GR(5) - I_GR(1) >= 0.10 ms for SHARED and PRIVATE
P1.scored_on: the 15 Granite GR (arm, n <= 5) cells, the median of 3 repeats each
P1.fails_if: more than 1 of the 15 cells falls outside its band, or either increment is under 0.10 ms
P1.rival_line: any GR cell at n <= 3 reading >= 0.20 ms: the GPU-side fixed-time rival predicts >= 0.23
P1.separates: host-paced instrument (GR follows C_reg) from a GPU-side fixed floor (GR stays near 0.25)

P2.says: GR = E240 on every GPU-bound cell
P2.scored_on: Granite n >= 7, JetMoE n >= 3, every arm (medians of 3 repeats)
P2.fails_if: any such cell off by more than the band: the graph changed the GPU work and P1 cannot be read
P2.separates: graph replay as a clean GPU-time instrument from one that alters the call

P3.says: E0 - E240 = F_trace - h_flush_trace - dD_tail on host-bound cells (the review's correction: the start event fires at t_flush_launch + lambda + F, so the flush's own host dispatch h_flush is not inside the E240 interval; first-order +0.068 ms - h_flush, about +0.053 to +0.063 ms for h_flush 5 to 15 us)
P3.inputs: F_trace and h_flush_trace from TR-E at E240, dD_tail = D_tail(TR-G at E0) - D_tail(TR-G at E240), all at the same (arm, n)
P3.fails_if: outside the band on more than 1 of the 6 cells
P3.without_traces: if a TR-E or TR-G trace at E0 or E240 for a cell is missing or unparsable, that cell is scored ONLY through MP (P6), never against the first-order number; the page states which cells
P3.separates: a host-paced interval (moves by the flush it hides) from a GPU floor (moves only by warm-L2 speed-up)

P4.says: E480 - E240 = -(F480 - F240) +/- 12 us on cells that stay host-bound (about -0.068 ms; Granite n = 1 about 0.18 ms); the crossover moves to C* = H - F480, about 0.219 ms
P4.scored_on: every non-edge Granite (arm, n) cell at E480 and E240
P4.fails_if: the moved verdict is wrong on more than 2 non-edge cells, or a shift is outside the band
P4.note: NATIVE n = 4 sits 4 us under C*: expected edge

P5.says: C_reg + F < H, each cell's own H, gives the E240 and E480 host-bound verdict
P5.scored_on: every non-edge cell of all three models, E240 and E480 (Granite-1B E240 only)
P5.note: post hoc 439/441 on the published pages: a low bar kept only because E480 moves the line; P4 is the real test

P6.says: MP (max-plus over 50 steady-state iterations: each kernel starts at max(previous end, launch + lambda)) predicts I_eager
P6.scored_on: every E240, E0 and E480 cell at the trace treads, host-bound and not, including JetMoE n = 1 (where constant Phi reads 5-8% fast)
P6.fails_if: any cell outside; a non-uniform profiler inflation is a way to fail without the mechanism being wrong, reported as an MP failure

P7.says: Granite n = 1: TR-G kernel sum <= 0.13 ms, non-GEMM kernels <= 0.03 ms, eager host span of fused_experts >= 0.25 ms with launch-API time under 40% of it
P7.role: classifies (Python dispatch vs launch API vs GPU), gates nothing

P8.says: host-bound wherever C_reg + 0.0676 < H_session; plateau I_E240 = H - Phi in [0.23, 0.27] ms; GR follows C_reg within P1's band
P8.plateau_band_label: FITTED ON GRANITE (SEEN): Phi and the band come from Granite-3.0-3B's published pages
P8.fails_if: P1's rule (more than 1 of 27 GR cells outside band) or P5's (< 95%) on this model

feeds: if P1 to P6 hold, R3's eager pages get the regime boundary C + F < H, host-bound cells leave the time test, and C is scored on GR cells; no T_floor is added to call_ms (the floor is the instrument's and the host's, not the GPU's)
scope: says nothing about fused_experts inside a forward pass, where production at small n is graph-captured
